title: Prime-Modulus Quadratic Gauss Sum and Legendre-Eigenstate Binary Sign Kickback
claims: For any odd prime p and non-zero residue z in F_p^x, the quadratic Gauss sum satisfies G(z; p) = (z/p)_L * eps_p * sqrt(p), where eps_p = 1 for p == 1 (mod 4) and eps_p = i for p == 3 (mod 4).
Phase kickback against the Legendre-weighted Fourier state extracts the exact multiplicative binary sign (a*s / p)_L = (a/p)_L * (s/p)_L in {-1, +1}.
favorable_controls: p in {5, 13} (p == 1 mod 4, real Gauss sums)
p in {7, 11} (p == 3 mod 4, imaginary Gauss sums)
